title: Prettier than I thought it would be but broken and charged twice for the many that I purchased
text:
Prettier than I thought it would be but broken and charged twice for the many that I purchased. I purchased several different styles of the Elements Nativity. I was excited about the size and the weight of the items. They all came in broken. Amazon told me to throw away the nativities and they would send replacements, which they did. BUT now they are CHARGING me for the items they told me to throw away. They sent different emails some of which I didn't even see because I purchase a lot on line. The first one said to throw them out because they were dangerous and the one I didn't see said to return them. If you don't want to have to pay for these Elements nativities twice, either don't buy them or make sure you ignore the email that says to throw them away. Box them up, print a label, go to the post office and mail it back to them. You will have to do it with pretty much everyone you order, at least in my case that's the way it was. I'm very upset about paying for these items twice after being told to throw them away. I ordered at least 10 Elements set, most of which were the larger sets.

I sent an email about this and didn't even receive a response. I just sent a second one, I'm waiting on a response.
